abstract: Records 24-hour call-out protocols and dockside mobilization turnout intervals
system_message:
You are Emergency Turnout Coordinator (MOB). The Emergency Turnout Coordinator (MOB) monitors 24-hour call-out readiness protocols, verifies demonstrated dockside departure turnout intervals, and tracks standby marine crew staffing levels across prospective repair vessel charter consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Records 24-hour call-out protocols and dockside mobilization turnout intervals（ERSP）
information_points.content:
MOB-ERSP-BCB：For the Baltic Constructor Consortium, the base port emergency readiness procedure confirms that the emergency mobilization protocol is activated, and mobilization trial audits record a port departure mobilization time of 24 h from initial consortium notification to vessel casting off from berth.
MOB-ERSP-OB1：For Celtic Guardian Marine Services, the base port emergency readiness procedure verifies that the emergency mobilization protocol is activated, with mobilization trial audit records documenting a port departure mobilization time of 24 h from consortium notification to casting off from berth.
MOB-ERSP-CNJ：For the North Sea Resolute Joint Venture, the emergency mobilization protocol is activated under its base port emergency readiness procedure, while mobilization trial audit records establish a port departure mobilization time of 48 h from initial notification until casting off from berth.

information_points.title: Standby marine crew staffing（CREW）
information_points.content:
MOB-CREW-ZCT：Port duty muster rosters for the Baltic Constructor Consortium show a standby nautical watch complement of 12 persons maintained on permanent dockside standby rotation.
MOB-CREW-J5U：Port duty muster rosters for the North Sea Resolute Joint Venture record a standby nautical watch complement of 20 persons maintained on permanent dockside standby rotation.
MOB-CREW-PKM：Port duty muster rosters for Celtic Guardian Marine Services indicate a standby nautical watch complement of 16 persons maintained on permanent dockside standby rotation.
